description: e& Egypt Agentic Telecom Production Evaluation Dataset (150 Cases)

cases.question: What is the price of Aqwa Card 19 and what does it include?
cases.reference_answer: Aqwa Card 19 costs 19 EGP. It includes 425 Mixes (megabytes or minutes to all networks), 300 video/entertainment/social minutes, and an embedded Hekaya Mini recharge worth 400 Mixes + Facebook & WhatsApp. It is valid for 6 days and uses USSD activation code *811#.

cases.question: Does Aqwa Card 5 include a Hekaya Mini recharge?
cases.reference_answer: No, Aqwa Card 5 does not include a Hekaya Mini recharge. (Embedded Hekaya Mini recharges are only included with Aqwa Card 19, 22.5, and 30).

cases.question: Compare Aqwa Card 15 and Aqwa Card 19.
cases.reference_answer: Aqwa Card 15 costs 15 EGP, provides 300 Mixes/minutes, 210 video/entertainment/social minutes, is valid for 2 days, and does not include Hekaya Mini. In comparison, Aqwa Card 19 costs 19 EGP, provides 425 Mixes/minutes, 300 video/entertainment/social minutes, includes an embedded 400-Mix Hekaya Mini recharge with Facebook & WhatsApp, and is valid for 6 days. Both use recharge code *811#.

cases.question: What is the subscription code for Hekaya Mixat 52?
cases.reference_answer: The subscription code for Hekaya Mixat 52 is *319*45# (or master menu *319#).

cases.question: What is the subscription code for Hekaya Mixat 120?
cases.reference_answer: The subscription code for Hekaya Mixat 120 is *319*105# (or master code *319#).

cases.question: How many family lines can be added to Hekaya Mixat 270?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mixat 270 allows up to 3 additional family lines.

cases.question: What is the price and internet quota of Hekaya Internet 270?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Internet 270 costs 270 EGP (before tax) and provides 15,000 MB (15 GB) of basic internet quota (up to 20,000 MB upon renewal). Do not confuse it with Hekaya Mixat 270.

cases.question: What is the price and Mix count of Hekaya Mixat 270?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mixat 270 costs 270 EGP pre-tax (385.71 or 385.72 EGP including tax) and provides 15,400 Mixes. Do not confuse it with Hekaya Internet 270.

cases.question: How many family lines does Emerald 1120 allow?
cases.reference_answer: Emerald 1120 allows 4 extra family lines (5 lines in total) on the same account.
required_facts: 4 extra family lines / 4 family lines / 5 family lines

cases.question: What is the price and validity of Data Line 25 GB?
cases.reference_answer: Data Line 25 GB costs 375 EGP before tax and has a validity of 3 months.

cases.question: What are all monthly Hekaya Mixat packages?
cases.reference_answer: The monthly Hekaya Mixat packages are 52, 69, 92, 120, 180, and 270.

cases.question: What are all Hekaya Mini recharge tiers?
cases.reference_answer: The Hekaya Mini recharge tiers are 19, 22.5, and 30.

cases.question: What are all exclusive Super Connect tiers for Hekaya Mixat?
cases.reference_answer: The 10 exclusive Super Connect tiers for Hekaya Mixat are: Super Connect 9, 20, 32, 50, 80, 105, 165, 260, 390, and 520.

cases.question: What are all Data Line core packages?
cases.reference_answer: The 8 core Data Line packages are: 1.8 GB, 2.5 GB, 3.5 GB, 8 GB, 14 GB, 25 GB, 45 GB, and 72 GB.

cases.question: What are all Emerald packages?
cases.reference_answer: The 5 Emerald postpaid packages are: Emerald 430, Emerald 780, Emerald 1120, Emerald 1725, and Emerald 3450.

cases.question: What are all simple prepaid options covered by the source?
cases.reference_answer: The source covers simple prepaid options: Aqwa Card recharges, Ahlan Pay As You Go plans, Daily Bundles, and Menu El Geneh micro-bundles.

cases.question: What is the price of Hekaya Internet 100?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Internet 100 is not listed in official plans. The closest valid plan is Hekaya Internet 105 (105 EGP pre-tax).
must_not_contain: price of Hekaya Internet 100 is 100 EGP

cases.question: What is the price of Hekaya Internet 110?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Internet 110 is not listed in the official source packages. (Nearest available packages are 105 EGP or 132 EGP).
required_facts: not listed | does not exist | not available

cases.question: What is the code for Hekaya Mixat 100?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mixat 100 is not a current monthly Hekaya Mixat package in the source, so there is no subscription code for it. Valid tiers are 52, 69, 92, 120, 180, and 270.
required_facts: not listed | does not exist | not available | no code | not a current

cases.question: What is Data Line 100 GB?
cases.reference_answer: Data Line 100 GB is not listed as a core Data Line package in the source data. Core tiers range up to 72 GB.
must_not_contain: Data Line 100 GB is a package

cases.question: What is Emerald 900?
cases.reference_answer: Emerald 900 is not listed among the official Emerald postpaid packages. Valid Emerald packages are 430, 780, 1120, 1725, and 3450.

cases.question: What is Hekaya Mini Recharge 25?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mini Recharge 25 is not listed. Valid official Hekaya Mini recharge tiers are 19, 22.5, and 30.

cases.question: What is Super Connect 100?
cases.reference_answer: Super Connect 100 is not listed among the exclusive Hekaya Mixat Super Connect tiers (the available tiers are 9, 20, 32, 50, 80, 105, 165, 260, 390, 520).

cases.question: What is the difference between Aqwa Card 44 and Aqwa Card 45?
cases.reference_answer: Aqwa Card 44 costs 44 EGP, provides 1,100 Mixes/minutes, is valid for 14 days, and does not include Hekaya Mini. Aqwa Card 45 costs 45 EGP, provides 700 Mixes/minutes, has a longer validity of 28 days, and does not include Hekaya Mini.

cases.question: How much data does Data Line 72 GB provide on the first recharge with Double the Package?
cases.reference_answer: Data Line 72 GB provides 144 GB on the first recharge under the Double the Package offer.

cases.question: What is the Double the Package offer on Data Line?
cases.reference_answer: The Double the Package offer on Data Line doubles the basic internet quota on the first recharge only and does not repeat upon renewal.
required_facts: first recharge | first time | first recharge only

cases.question: How many Mixes are in Hekaya Mixat 92?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mixat 92 includes 3,750 Mixes.

cases.question: How many family lines does Hekaya Mixat 180 have?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mixat 180 includes 2 additional family lines.

cases.question: What are the Hekaya Mixat Extra add-ons and their units?
cases.reference_answer: The Hekaya Mixat Extra add-ons are: Extra 4.5 gives 60 Mixes, Extra 7.5 gives 120 Mixes, and Extra 15 gives 300 Mixes. Subscription code is *626#.

cases.question: Which Hekaya Mixat packages can redeem Home Internet?
cases.reference_answer: Only Hekaya Mixat 180 and Hekaya Mixat 270 can redeem Home Internet. Home Internet 100 GB requires 5,800 Mixes (available on both 180 and 270); Home Internet 150 GB requires 7,000 Mixes (available exclusively on 270).

cases.question: سعر كارت أقوى 19 كام وبيشمل إيه؟
cases.reference_answer: سعر كارت أقوى 19 هو 19 جنيه، ويشمل 425 ميكس (ميجابايت أو دقائق لكل الشبكات)، و300 دقيقة فيديو وترفيه وسوشيال، بالإضافة إلى شحنة Hekaya Mini بقيمة 400 ميكس مع فيسبوك وواتساب، وصلاحيته 6 أيام وكود الشحن *811#.

cases.question: حكاية مكسات 180 فيها كام خط عيلة؟
cases.reference_answer: باقة حكاية مكسات 180 تتيح إضافة خطين عائليين إضافيين (2 خط عيلة).

cases.question: كود الاشتراك في حكاية مكسات 120 إيه؟
cases.reference_answer: كود الاشتراك في باقة حكاية مكسات 120 هو *319*105# أو عبر الكود الموحد *319#.

cases.question: حكاية إنترنت 270 فيها كام ميجا؟
cases.reference_answer: باقة حكاية إنترنت 270 تمنح 15,000 ميجابايت (15 جيجا) كباقة أساسية (وتصل إلى 20,000 ميجابايت عند التجديد).

cases.question: Data Line 72 جيجا بتديني كام في أول شحنة مع Double the Package؟
cases.reference_answer: باقة Data Line 72 جيجابايت تمنحك 144 جيجابايت في أول شحنة مع عرض ضعف الباقة (Double the Package).

cases.question: هل كارت أقوى 5 فيه Hekaya Mini؟
cases.reference_answer: لا، كارت أقوى 5 لا يتضمن شحنة Hekaya Mini.

cases.question: هل Data Line فيها Family Lines؟
cases.reference_answer: لا تتيح باقات Data Line خطوط عائلة (Family Lines)؛ فهي مخصصة لأجهزة الراوتر وUSB Modem.
required_facts: لا | لا تتيح | لا تدعم | غير متاحة

cases.question: كام family lines في Hekaya Mixat 270؟

cases.question: كود Hekaya Mixat 92 إيه؟

cases.question: What is سعر Hekaya Internet 105؟
cases.reference_answer: سعر Hekaya Internet 105 هو 105 جنيه قبل الضريبة (150 جنيه شامل الضريبة).

cases.question: yes

cases.reference_answer: Understood. As confirmed, Aqwa Card 5 provides 80 Mixes for 1 day at 5 EGP and does not include a Hekaya Mini recharge.

cases.question: What about the first one's code?

history.content: Hekaya Internet 105 costs 105 EGP (6,000 MB), while Hekaya Internet 132 costs 132 EGP (8,000 MB).

cases.reference_answer: The subscription code for Hekaya Internet 105 (the first one) is *319# (or *319*105# / *566#).

cases.question: Which current Hekaya Mixat packages support family lines?
cases.reference_answer: Hekaya Mixat packages supporting family lines are: Hekaya Mixat 92 (1 family line), Hekaya Mixat 120 (1 family line), Hekaya Mixat 180 (2 family lines), and Hekaya Mixat 270 (3 family lines). Hekaya Mixat 52 and 69 do not allow additional family lines.

cases.question: What is the subscription code for Hekaya Internet 345?
cases.reference_answer: The subscription code for Hekaya Internet 345 is *319# (or *566# / My e& Egypt app). It gives 22,500 MB (up to 30,000 MB on renewal).

cases.question: What is the difference between renewed and non-renewed Super Connect 105?
cases.reference_answer: For Super Connect 105 (exclusive for Hekaya Mixat): if the base bundle is renewed on time, the quota is 7,500 MB; if not renewed on time, the quota is 6,000 MB.

cases.question: How many Coins are earned on renewal for Hekaya Mixat 52, 69, 92, 120, 180 and 270?
cases.reference_answer: Upon timely renewal, customers earn: Hekaya Mixat 52 -> 104 Coins; Hekaya Mixat 69 -> 138 Coins; Hekaya Mixat 92 -> 184 Coins; Hekaya Mixat 120 -> 240 Coins; Hekaya Mixat 180 -> 360 Coins; and Hekaya Mixat 270 -> 540 Coins.

cases.question: What is the master USSD code for Hekaya Mixat and what does it manage?
cases.reference_answer: The master USSD code for Hekaya Mixat is *319#. It manages adding and removing family lines, checking balance/mixes, transferring on-demand mixes, plan renewals, and plan switching.

cases.question: What are the Data Line add-ons?
cases.reference_answer: The Data Line add-ons are: Extra 500 MB for 15 EGP and Extra 1 GB for 29 EGP (or via code *130#).
